defs.def: in, at or to another place 在（或去、到）别处

ex.s: Whole neighbourhoods were destroyed to make way for new road networks and kids had to play elsewhere.
ex.t: "我没做，先生，"我争辩道，但他眼中满是____怀疑。

ex.s: well predicted by researchersD. shown elsewhere in the world
ex.t: 我正准备离开时，那只蜂鸟出现了。

ex.s: Or perhaps a design works so well it is adopted elsewhere again and again, with seemingly harmless improvements, until, suddenly, it does not work at all anymore.
ex.t: 读者将不仅遇到他们以前听过的故事，还有一些新故事，以及对工程师对公众的责任和帮助年轻工程师理解这些责任的方式的深入讨论。

ex.s: They wanted to try their luck elsewhere.
ex.t: 比以往任何时候都更努力工作 D. 依赖外国建筑师

ex.s: Throughout the colonial period, tobacco was used in lieu of coins or paper bills in Virginia, Maryland and North Carolina, even though it was used elsewhere in the colonies and extensively throughout Europe and the UK
ex.t: 在马莱塔——所罗门群岛人口最多的岛屿——贝壳在大多数地方都被接受，"你的贝壳能换多少金枪鱼取决于它们的颜色和形状，"来自马莱塔小镇奥基的店主玛丽·布鲁诺告诉Vice杂志。

ex.s: Elsewhere in Asia even more astonishing actions are being taken.
ex.t: 在亚洲其他地方，甚至更令人惊叹的行动正在被采取。

ex.s: Although endangered elsewhere in China due to the invasion of foreign species, the bees of Shennongjia have coexisted with the local people for centuries.
ex.t: 尽管由于外来物种的入侵，中国其他地方的蜜蜂濒临灭绝，但神农架的蜜蜂已经与当地人共存了几个世纪。

ex.s: So far, the camp has inspired hundreds of thousands of young people from the US and from elsewhere around the world.
ex.t: 到目前为止，这个营地已经激励了来自美国以及世界其他地方的数十万年轻人。

ex.s: It is often the first sentence, but sometimes it is found elsewhere in the paragraph.
ex.t: 它通常是第一句，但有时也出现在段落的其他地方。

ex.s: Elsewhere, people favour shaking hands, bowing from the waist, or nodding the head when they meet someone else.
ex.t: 在其他地方，人们喜欢握手、鞠躬或者点头来互相打招呼。
